The potential evapotranspiration of a crop or land cover, as crop coefficient times the reference evapotranspiration, given or calculated with the modified Hargreaves equation (as in InVEST).

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** potential, evapotranspiration<br>
**Authors:** The klab team.<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.PotentialEvapotranspiredWaterVolume`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inCropCoefficient` | raster file |  |  | The map of the crop coefficient (Kc). |
| `inMaxTemp` | raster file | °C |  | The map of the mean daily maximum temperature of the timestep, for the Hargreaves equation. |
| `inMinTemp` | raster file | °C |  | The map of the mean daily minimum temperature of the timestep, for the Hargreaves equation. |
| `inAtmosphericTemp` | raster file | °C |  | The map of the mean daily temperature of the timestep, for the Hargreaves equation. |
| `inSolarRadiation` | raster file | MJ/m2/day |  | The map of the mean daily extraterrestrial radiation of the timestep, for the Hargreaves equation. |
| `inRainfall` | raster file | mm |  | The map of the precipitation of the timestep, for the Hargreaves equation. |
| `inReferenceEtp` | raster file | mm |  | The map of the reference evapotranspiration of the timestep (if set, only the crop coefficient is needed). |
| `pDaysInTimestep` | Double |  |  | The days of the timestep, used with the Hargreaves equation (if not set, 30, for a month). |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outputPet` | output file | mm | The potential evapotranspiration of the timestep. |

**Notes**

The potential evapotranspiration of each cell is its crop coefficient (Kc) times the reference evapotranspiration. The reference evapotranspiration can be given as a map, or calculated with the modified Hargreaves equation of Droogers and Allen (2002), as suggested by InVEST when only temperatures and precipitation are available:

ET0 = 0.0013 · 0.408 · RA · (Tavg + 17) · (Tmax - Tmin - 0.0123 · P)^0.76 · days

with RA the mean daily extraterrestrial radiation in MJ/m2/day (0.408 converts it to mm of water), the mean daily temperatures in °C, P the precipitation of the timestep in mm and days the days of the timestep. In wet timesteps with a small temperature range, where the precipitation term exceeds the range, the reference evapotranspiration is 0.

- Droogers, P., Allen, R. G. (2002). Estimating reference evapotranspiration under inaccurate data conditions. Irrigation and Drainage Systems, 16(1), 33-45.
